notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The reference is the STEP tessellated by scadmesh tessellate, as the SOURCE paragraph of 920-002_DynamicFinger.scad's header gives, with the slit it carried at L2's root closed, as the GATE paragraph gives. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation. The revised one gives the rail's bearing faces and W1's chamfers their slip fit in the Static Finger's T-slot, and G1's flanks their backlash against the Pinion Gear, as the FITS paragraph of the header gives. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
